verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents its own workflow triggers that notify, update, or validate records, plus automatic bank-feed import and categorization, so some background automation is native. Zoho MCP's "fully autonomous agents" depend on an external LLM agent, so they add little first-party credit. The depth of the native automation is thinly documented. Missing for 10: documented trigger types and configuration detail, time-based or recurring scheduled automations, evidence of unattended agent execution inside Books itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Trigger workflow: Easily create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information
